STRING protein network analysis of the altered SLOS proteome

STRING protein network analysis was conducted using the differentially expressed proteins in all SLOS individuals. Altered proteins involved in the “Granin family,” “Reelin signaling pathway,” “Cholesterol binding,” and “Cholesterol transfer activity” are highlighted
Download JPG
View figure at PMC Read paper at PMC

Publication

Altered Cerebrospinal Fluid Proteins in Smith-Lemli-Opitz Syndrome (2025) Wenping Li, et al. J Proteome Res. 2025 Aug 01;24(8). Figure: F3.
